remarks: Welcome to 50 Aiken Street, Unit 225 in the desirable Rolling Ridge condominumn community. Enjoy the beautiful parklike setting with picturesque pond, fountain and walk-ways. Amenities include an in-ground pool, a picnic area, a paddle tennis court and a dog path. Make this one your own and add your personal style and updates to this open and spacious one bedroom unit. Generous living room and an adjoining dining area that opens onto a private, covered deck with serene views of the beautifully landscaped "Rolling Ridge" complex. Balcony off the dining area overlooking mature plantings. Heat and hot water included. Complex feels secluded and private, yet offers easy access to Route 7, the Merritt Parkway and I-95 and everything that Norwalk has to offer. Additional highlights include ample off-street private parking, and the convenience of an in-unit stackable washer and dryer. Make your home ownership dreams a reality! Being sold AS-IS.
